testcase.name: Scenario: Dismiss the remaining title strip of a hidden expanded panel: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:506:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss the remaining title strip of a hidden expanded panel ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon at the top ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user opens the panel selector and clears Modify ✔ Then the Modify main panel and additional commands are hidden ✔ And a small Modify title strip remains beneath the ribbon ✔ And the panel selector remains open with Modify unchecked ✔ When the user clicks the remaining Modify title strip ✔ Then the title strip and panel selector close ✔ And the Modify panel remains hidden ✔ When the user opens the panel selector and selects Modify ✔ Then the Modify main panel returns ✔ And the additional command area remains closed ✔ And the panel selector remains open with Modify checked ✔ When the user clicks the panel selector control ✔ Then the selector closes and the Modify main panel remains visible
